payload.reason: The evidence provides specific baseline methods used for comparison in the study, detailing their characteristics and approaches.

claims.text: The baseline methods include: (1) Naive: a bag-of-words SVM classifier; (2) mSDA: a state-of-the-art method with discrete features; (3) NaiveNN: a non-domain-adaptive CNN; (4) AuxNN: a neural model using auxiliary tasks; (5) ADAN: a method using adversarial training; (6) MMD: a method minimizing domain discrepancy.
